_comment: Portable GitHub ruleset payload for the `main` branch.
Mirrors terraform/github/branch-protection.tf for teams that prefer to apply
the policy via `gh api` without running Terraform. See
docs/github-branch-protection.md for the full policy specification.
jq 'walk(if type == "object" then del(._comment) else . end)' \
Bypass actors are intentionally an empty list - admin / maintainer
bypass is disabled. The Terraform module exposes a
`break_glass_team_slug` variable for teams that want to grant
PR-mode bypass to a documented incident-response team. To match
that here, append a bypass_actors entry of shape:
name: main-protection

parameters._comment: SOLO-DEV: single-owner repo — peer review is disabled (count 0) so the owner can self-merge once CI passes. required_signatures rule intentionally omitted to remove bot/automation merge friction. Keep in sync with terraform/github/main.tf var.required_review_count and branch-protection.tf.
